blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The project engineer in the allegedly substandard road dike project in Oriental Mindoro on Tuesday told the Sandiganbayan Sixth Division that he was not aware that contractor Sunwest was conducting construction work at night. Felisardo Casuno, who used to be with the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Region IV-B office, made this known during the continuation of his testimony to defend himself before the court where he faces a charge of malversation through falsification of public documents, with former Ako Bicol party-list Rep. Zaldy Co as co-accused. READ: Mindoro village chief tags Sunwest in anomalous flood […]... Keep on reading: Accused ex-DPWH exec says he didn’t know Sunwest worked at night
